critical_items.note: Issuer, intermediary, file details confirmed from Form C XML and PDF.
Common Stock; no SAFE or note offered.
Subscription Agreement (Exhibit B, doc 9 pp. 53-63) is in the pack and was read. Lacks the charter/bylaws, which govern dividends and liquidation preference.
Price $1.00 per share, arbitrary; no cap or discount in the common-stock contract (valuation cap mention is boilerplate). Existing notes' conversion price is not disclosed (A20).
Minimum $500 and issuer-paid intermediary compensation are cited, but investor-side fees (e.g. platform/custody/processing) are not stated in the pack; user must confirm.
Audited FY2025/FY2024 statements present; Form C XML debt fields differ from the balance sheet (A15). Cash figure as of 2026-06-18 is unaudited.
Platform page not verified; no closing evidence; only a Form C deadline.

missing_information: Evidence that the offering is currently open on Republic (platform page unreachable); amount raised to date or any closing.
Investor-side fees (platform, custody, processing) not stated.
Certificate of Incorporation and bylaws (govern dividends, liquidation preference, transfer).
Conversion price, discount, valuation cap and Liquidity Event definitions for the two convertible notes; the note instruments themselves.
Mouse study report, protocol and sample size; independent corroboration of science and market claims.
Evidence of patents (registrations, assignments) and of any FDA contact, IND or IRB approval.
Evidence of third-party partnerships, distributors, clinics or device manufacturers.
Monthly burn basis behind the 'six months of runway' claim; any interim financials after 12/31/2025.
Basis for ratification of 75,000,000 founder shares and treatment of the 1-share balance at year-end.
Auditor going-concern paragraph status (report text shows none) and auditor independence beyond the stated assertion.
Details of the related-party payable ($199,875) repayment terms.
